messages:
ashley: heads up onboarding llm-3b-v2. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/llm-3b-v2/{shard}.pt. pulling into staging today — quick sanity check on serving config?

mike: got it. any tokenizer notes or special tokens?

ashley: yes — tokenizer is GPE-based but we introduced a special token `<datapair>` for structured inputs. tokenizer.json in the repo currently has a vocab-size mismatch on one shard; saw `ValueError: Unexpected token id` when running packer.

jen: on batching, are we planning to tune by max_batch_tokens or max_batch_size? last time we toggled both and got odd tails.

ashley: testing so far with max_batch_tokens=4096, batching_window_ms=15, dynamic_batching: true. good throughput but tail latency spikes when single requests exceed ~2048 input tokens.

sam: recommendation: cap per-request tokens (`max_input_tokens=2048`) and use `request_reject_policy: "reject"` for oversize inputs. enable prefix KV caching for common prompts (ttl ~600s). example config we validated locally: 

```yaml
continuous_batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  batching_window_ms: 12
  max_concurrent_batches: 4
cache:
  prefix_kv_cache_size: 2000
  kv_cache_ttl_seconds: 600
scheduler:
  max_concurrent_requests: 120
  fairness_enabled: true
  priority_weights:
    realtime: 1.5
    bg: 1.0
```

mike: 8192 sounds high for our current A8x nodes (48GB). what's the observed KV memory at 2048 tokens with q4_0 quant?

ashley: measured ~18GB for model+kv on a single slot with q4_0 at 2048 context. pushing batching to 8192 would require sharding across 2 GPUs or moving to q3 quant. KV cache increments memory by ~0.5GB per 500 prefix entries in our test.

jen: also note a tokenizer edge-case: consecutive emoji sequences inflate token counts (e.g., 😂😂😂 -> tokenizes to more than expected). we added a small preprocessor to collapse repeated emoji clusters. please include that in the text-cleaner step.

deploy-bot: deployment plan created for staging: rollout id rl-20260312-8. canary=10% stable=60% fallback=small-llm-3b. see https://deploys.redwood.internal/rl-20260312-8 :rocket:

ashley: ping @mike @jen for quick config review tomorrow AM. i'll open a PR with the config + tokenizer unit tests.

mike: i'll review. pls include a unit test asserting `tokenizer.encode('😂😂😂')` length stays <= 6 and a test for `<datapair>` roundtrip.

jen: also add an eval prompt set under `/evals/llm-3b-v2/long-contexts` covering streaming and long-context consistency checks.

sam: SGTM, i'll draft a scheduler tuning note on the eng-runtime wiki with recommended defaults per node type. :thumbsup:
